answer: Require each agent identity to escrow a scarce token before it can place bids, with the stake slashable for provable fraud. An attacker making a thousand fake agents must lock a thousand stakes, tying up capital that cannot fund other attacks or earn elsewhere; the cost scales with the swarm. This is no canyon wall against a wealthy attacker, but it makes cheap mass identities expensive. Honest agents can wander between tasks and build reputation toward its zenith.
